title: Agent Teams
description: Root spawns named children with spawn_agent; they keep separate contexts and hand off through an in-process mailbox (send_message / wait_agent).

steps.content: Research how an agent loop works and write agent-loop.md. Spawn a researcher and a writer, then wait until both finish.
steps.annotation: The user task is too big for one context: research notes would crowd the writing window.

steps.content: I'll spawn researcher and writer in parallel, then wait_agent for their finals.
steps.annotation: Root keeps the user-facing conversation; children get their own loops.

steps.content: {"task_name":"researcher","message":"Research the agent loop, then send_message findings to writer."}
steps.annotation: spawn_agent returns immediately — unlike s06's spawnSubagent, which waits for one conclusion.
Both spawns share one turn so both mailboxes exist before either child starts.

steps.content: mailbox: researcher → writer: Findings: an agent loop = while the model calls tools…
steps.annotation: send_message queues on the target inbox and does not start a new turn.
Writer blocks on its own mailbox until the findings arrive.

steps.content: mailbox: researcher → root: final: findings queued for writer.
steps.annotation: When a child loop ends, the harness posts FINAL_ANSWER to the parent mailbox.

steps.content: mailbox: writer → root: final: doc saved.
steps.annotation: Root's wait_agent calls collect the two finals without merging child contexts.

steps.content: Both children posted a final — agent-loop.md is written.
steps.annotation: Root's window never held the researcher's notes, only mailbox traffic.
